findings.passage: As a combat veteran, Cait has fired everything from a machine gun to a tank. She is a gun owner who respects the Second Amendment and understands common-sense gun safety measures. She also knows firsthand the devastation weapons of war can cause, and understands they do not belong on our streets or in our schools.

findings.passage: In Congress, Cait will work for common-sense gun safety measures backed by the vast majority of Americans, including: Passing Universal background checks to protect lawful gun owners while stopping criminals. Closing the loophole that exempts unlicensed dealers (gun shows, online sales, private transfers). Supporting federal grants to help states adopt extreme danger (“red flag”) laws that respect due process and keep guns out of the hands of domestic abusers or those who might do themselves harm.
